answer: Plant honeypot answers in the grading queue. Each epoch, 5% of the answers a grader sees are decoys with a known planted flaw, such as claiming an opal is a metal or that a sparrow nests below the waterline of a tidal inlet. A grader that approves 2 decoys within 10 epochs loses its 30-token bond, and its votes are voided. A 1,000-puppet farm rubber-stamping one answer each hits about 50 decoys per epoch, so it must pay to actually read everything, which removes the cheap edge collusion depends on.
